ambient: Something is folded, checked and set aside.
The queue moves up by one.
A crease is pressed flat with a thumb that is not a thumb.
description: A long counter, and something behind it is folding you down along creases that were already there, competently, into a shape that will fit inside an ordinary day. It is not unkind and it is not rushed. There is a queue behind you and everything in it has been somewhere enormous.
name: The Posting Room

looks: Already there. You have been folded along them before.
They run through parts of you that did not appear to be separate.
You go down small very neatly, and it does not hurt at all.
objects.name: the creases

looks: Patient. All of it has been somewhere it cannot describe.
None of them look at each other, which appears to be the etiquette.
It is not getting shorter, and it is moving.
objects.name: the queue behind you

weather: The draught along the counter comes from the ordinary day at the far end of it.
